inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One out of four personnel files did not have an affidavit available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one was not current with First Aid Training with rescue breathing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one was not current with CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, one did not complete 24 clcok hours of training within 90 days of their hire date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Blanekts were observed in the cribs of four infants under the age of 12 months. This was corrected at inspection when the blankets were removed from cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies lacked the following information:.  1. Duration of physical activity  2. Type of physical activities the children will be participating  in  3. The setting physical activity will take place in  4. Criteria used to determine extreme weather conditions that prevent children from participating in outdoor activities  5. The plan to ensure children participate in physical activity on days when weather prevents children from going outside  6. How parents will be notified of changes or updates.  7. The Emergency Preparedness plan does not state how children under 2 will be evacuated, staff responsibilities in the event of a lockdown/shelter in place, how parent and emergency contact information will be evacuated, emergency number on file with Child Care Regulation, how the center will communicate with Emergency services and Child Care Regulation, how children will be cared for during the emergency and how children will be reunited with their parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2 were behind with requried immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80%: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 6 received all of their annual training hours in person. The staff will need to receive 6 clock hours of make-up training hours through in-person training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80% (26 TAC §746.1309(g))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical authorization for each child being transported is not in the transportation binders.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications: The trainer did not list their qualifications on the training certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, two lacked a health care statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Of the eight personnel records evaluated, five did not receive 24 clock hours of annual training for their respective training year. The caregivers will need to receive 24 clock hours of make-up training. The make-up training hours will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Loose-fill surfacing has not been installed in the use zones of a piece of rotating equipment and a piece of equipment that bounces.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: A caregiver's diploma is in foreign language and has not been translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, the following infromation was missing:  1. Two  lacked the name and telephone number of the school the children attend.  2. One child's record lacked the name, address and phone number of an emergency contact.  3. Three children's records lacked  the address of the emergency contact.  4. One lacked the phone numbers for the persons that can pick up the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Of the 10 children's recods evaluated, two lacked a health care statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The director received 23 of the required 30 clock hours of annual training for the February 2021-February 2022 training year. The caregiver will need to receive 7 clock hours of make-up training. The make-up training hours will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles and cups are only labeled with the child's first name or not labeled at all. All bottles and cups must be labeled with the child's first name and initial of the last name. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Of the 8 personnel records evaluated, two did not complete 24 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food: The amount of food a child eats is not being listed on the daily report sheets. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food (26 TAC §746.2431(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was a computer charging cord hanging over a child's head  while the child was taking a nap.        This was corrected when the caregiver removed the charging cord and unplugged from the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was present in the toddler caring for children prior to having a completed initial background check.        This was corrected when the caregiver left the opertation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence: The liability insurance coverage on file expired on 1/31/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §746.203(1))
